title: Zesty Mexican Mung Bean Sprouts Tacos
description: A fresh and light Mexican dish featuring mung bean sprouts, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this pescatarian-friendly recipe is made in a hot pot vessel and uses an air fryer for crispy texture.
instructions: Rinse the mung bean sprouts and drain well.
In a hot pot vessel, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the shrimp to the hot pot vessel and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the shrimp from the hot pot vessel and set aside.
Add the cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper to the hot pot vessel and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mung bean sprouts to the hot pot vessel and cook until they start to soften, about 2 minutes.
Add the lime juice to the hot pot vessel and stir to combine.
Using an air fryer, cook the mung bean sprouts mixture for an additional 2 minutes, until crispy.
Warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a portion of the mung bean sprouts mixture onto a tortilla, followed by a piece of cooked shrimp and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
